subject: 英语
topic: Unit 4 I have a pen pal
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】dancing 跳舞; singing 唱歌; reading stories 读故事; playing football 踢足球; doing kung fu 练武术; studies 学习（单三）; puzzles 谜题; hiking 远足
【重点句型】What are your hobbies? 你的爱好是什么？ I like ... 我喜欢…… He/She likes ... 他/她喜欢…… Does he ...? 他……吗？ Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't. 是的。/ 不是。
【A Let's talk】Peter: What are your hobbies? Zhang Peng: I like reading stories and doing kung fu. Peter: Really? I like those, too! Zhang Peng: Does Oliver like word puzzles? Peter: Yes, he does.
【Read and write】I have a pen pal. His name is Peter. He lives in Australia. His hobbies are singing and dancing. He likes doing kung fu and reading stories. He studies Chinese every day. He likes hiking, too. We often write emails.
key_points: What are your hobbies? 你的爱好是什么？
Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't. 是的。/ 不是。
